scope: Complete membership and positional evidence needed to select FeatureReferenceExpression results through the shared reducer.

sourceAnchors.name: checkFeatureReferenceExpressionBindingConnector
expressions: A FeatureReferenceExpression must have an ownedMember that is a BindingConnector between the referent and result of the FeatureReferenceExpression.
ownedMember->selectByKind(BindingConnector)->exists(b |     b.relatedFeatures->includes(targetFeature) and     b.relatedFeatures->includes(result))

sourceAnchors.name: checkFeatureReferenceExpressionResultSpecialization
expressions: The result parameter of a FeatureReferenceExpression must specialize the referent of the FeatureReferenceExpression.
result.owningType() = self and result.specializes(referent)

sourceAnchors.name: deriveFeatureReferenceExpressionReferent
expressions: The referent of a FeatureReferenceExpression is the memberElement of its first ownedMembership that is not a ParameterMembership.

referent =     let nonParameterMemberships : Sequence(Membership) = ownedMembership->         reject(oclIsKindOf(ParameterMembership)) in     if nonParameterMemberships->isEmpty() or        not nonParameterMemberships->first().memberElement.oclIsKindOf(Feature)     then null     else nonParameterMemberships->first().memberElement.oclAsType(Feature)     endif

sourceAnchors.name: deriveExpressionResult
expressions: The result parameter of an Expression is its parameter owned (possibly in a supertype) via a ReturnParameterMembership (if any).

result =     let resultParams : Sequence(Feature) =         featureMemberships->             selectByKind(ReturnParameterMembership).             ownedMemberParameter in     if resultParams->notEmpty() then resultParams->first()     else null     endif

sourceAnchors.name: checkExpressionResultBindingConnector
expressions: If an Expression has an Expression owned via a ResultExpressionMembership, then the owning Expression must also own a BindingConnector between its result parameter and the result parameter of the result Expression.

ownedMembership.selectByKind(ResultExpressionMembership)->     forAll(mem | ownedFeature.selectByKind(BindingConnector)->         exists(binding |             binding.relatedFeature->includes(result) and             binding.relatedFeature->includes(mem.ownedResultExpression.result)))

sourceAnchors.name: inheritedMemberships
expressions: removeRedefinedFeatures( inheritableMemberships(excludedNamespaces, excludedTypes, excludeImplied))

Return the Memberships inheritable from supertypes of this Type with redefined Features removed. When computing inheritable Memberships, exclude Imports of excludedNamespaces, Specializations of excludedTypes, and, if excludeImplied = true, all implied Specializations.

sourceAnchors.name: removeRedefinedFeatures
expressions: let reducedMemberships : Sequence(Membership) =     memberships->reject(mem1 |         memberships->excluding(mem1)->             exists(mem2 | allRedefinedFeaturesOf(mem2)->                 includes(mem1.memberElement))) in let redefinedFeatures : Set(Feature) =      ownedFeature.redefinition.redefinedFeature->asSet() in reducedMemberships->reject(mem | allRedefinedFeaturesOf(mem)->     exists(feature | redefinedFeatures->includes(feature)))

Return a subset of memberships, removing those Memberships whose memberElements are Features and for which either of the following two conditions holds:

  1. The memberElement of the Membership is included in redefined Features of another Membership in memberships.
  2. One of the redefined Features of the Membership is a directly redefinedFeature of an ownedFeature of this Type.

For this purpose, the redefined Features of a Membership whose memberElement is a Feature includes the memberElement and all Features directly or indirectly redefined by the memberElement.

sourceAnchors.name: deriveTypeInheritedMembership
expressions: The inheritedMemberships of a Type are determined by the inheritedMemberships() operation.
inheritedMembership = inheritedMemberships(Set{}, Set{}, false)

sourceAnchors.name: deriveTypeOwnedFeatureMembership
expressions: The ownedFeatureMemberships of a Type are its ownedMemberships that are FeatureMemberships.
ownedFeatureMembership = ownedRelationship->selectByKind(FeatureMembership)

sourceAnchors.name: deriveTypeFeatureMembership
expressions: The featureMemberships of a Type is the union of the ownedFeatureMemberships and those inheritedMemberships that are FeatureMemberships.
featureMembership = ownedFeatureMembership->union( inheritedMembership->selectByKind(FeatureMembership))

sourceAnchors.name: checkFeatureParameterRedefinition
expressions:
If a Feature is a parameter of an owningType that is a Behavior or Step, but not

  • A result parameter
  • A parameter of an InvocationExpression, with at least one non-implied ownedRedefinition

then, for each direct supertype of its owningType that is also a Behavior or Step, it must redefine the parameter at the same position, if any.

owningType <> null and not owningFeatureMembership.     oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership) and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Behavior) or  owningType.oclIsKindOf(Step) and     (owningType.oclIsKindOf(InvocationExpression) implies       not ownedRedefinition->exists(not isImplied))  implies     let i : Integer =         owningType.ownedFeature->select(direction <> null)->             reject(owningFeatureMembership.                 oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership))->             indexOf(self) in     owningType.ownedSpecialization.general->         forAll(supertype |             let ownedParameters : Sequence(Feature) =                 supertype.ownedFeature->select(direction <> null)->                      reject(owningFeatureMembership.                          oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership)) in             ownedParameters->size() >= i implies                 redefines(ownedParameters->at(i))

sourceAnchors.name: checkFeatureEndRedefinition
expressions: If a Feature has isEnd = true and an owningType that is not empty, then, for each direct supertype of its owningType, it must redefine the endFeature at the same position, if any.

isEnd and owningType <> null implies     let i : Integer =          owningType.ownedEndFeature->indexOf(self) in     owningType.ownedSpecialization.general->         forAll(supertype |              supertype.endFeature->size() >= i implies                 redefines(supertype.endFeature->at(i))

sourceAnchors.name: checkFeatureResultRedefinition
expressions: If a Feature is a result parameter of an owningType that is a Function or Expression, then, for each direct supertype of its owningType that is also a Function or Expression, it must redefine the result parameter.

owningType <> null and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Function) and     self = owningType.oclAsType(Function).result or  owningType.oclIsKindOf(Expression) and     self = owningType.oclAsType(Expression).result) implies     owningType.ownedSpecialization.general->         select(oclIsKindOf(Function) or oclIsKindOf(Expression))->         forAll(supertype |             redefines(                 if superType.oclIsKindOf(Function) then                     superType.oclAsType(Function).result                 else                     superType.oclAsType(Expression).result                 endif)

probe.library: All 94 bundled model files loaded through Model.load_library_dir
probe.boundary: Compatibility queries locate candidate results and inspect membership shape only. The checked result and feature-domain reports establish their distinct reported capabilities; a compatibility candidate is not accepted as a complete result selector.

findings: Direct, inherited and ordinary duration arguments, an absolute-time argument, and the inner reference of the conditional when argument each have a checked generated-result feature domain. Their source ExpressionResultReport remains UnsupportedConfiguration. The literal when case selects its result successfully through the new checked report.

Every probed reference source has a nonowning referent Membership, a generated ReturnParameterMembership, and an OwningMembership for the generated BindingConnector in its materialized membership view. The stored-source relationship list has no generated return membership.

The checked Type provider gathers all Feature-valued members for redefinition reduction, including a foreign referent and the owned binding. Its existing foreign-feature exception and proof-only owner scheduling cover imports, not general nonowning memberships. BindingConnector under OwningMembership has no owningType and also needs a reviewed redefinition domain.

plan_checked_positional compares the checked node against owned_member_elems and positional_owned_memberships, both of which read stored source relationships. The common planner repeats those selectors. Simply admitting the reference metaclass would therefore not establish agreement with the materialized membership sequence.

The positional planner gathers authored redefinitions from spec_targets and spec_resolved. Generated result redefinitions have a separate publication certificate. A shared consumer input contract must account for those current edges without treating absent authored entries as a complete generated closure.

owned_feature_projection_complete is used to qualify negative has-owned-feature evidence during feature conformance; it is not the sole membership-provider gate. Relaxing this Boolean would neither solve the provider/planner mismatch nor certify required generated construction.
implementationRequirements: Keep one inheritance/redefinition reducer and one positional algorithm. Define how checked semantic nodes and their current redefinition evidence reach that algorithm; keep construction-time planning over its admitted candidate graph explicit.

Audit every membership-producing obligation of the admitted reference source, including generated result and binding provenance, existing results, additional explicit bases and ResultExpressionMembership. A generated result identity alone is not sufficient.

Generalize foreign member proof dependencies without turning their declaring owners into inheritance contributions. Schedule foreign parameter/end/result dependencies before their redefinitions influence a consuming node.
Prove the generated binding member redefinition domain and preserve ownership distinctions. Do not change its OwningMembership to FeatureMembership merely to satisfy the current provider.

Keep incomplete dependencies, stale publication, contradictory aliases, collisions, cycles and budget exhaustion explicitly unknown. Source/projected graph agreement must be verified before publishing a complete result.
acceptancePartitions: Package and nested referents; direct, inherited and redefined feature types; borrowed members owned by unrelated classifiers/functions; exact identities and order.
Authored and generated return memberships, additional inherited returns and result redefinitions; no result, multiple results and missing library evidence remain distinct.
Generated binding ownership and both endpoint identities; removal or mutation of generated carrier, result, binding, redefinition and metadata evidence after a warm query.
Foreign positional dependencies, role-free relays, strict ancestor targets, cross-owner cycles and unresolved targets; proof dependencies do not appear as inherited features.
Cold and warm queries, prepared-library replay, both graph formats, work-limit retry, no row publication by readers, and unchanged existing construction behavior.
Checked report/property agreement and all six full-library trigger examples, followed by the complete trigger-rule positive/negative partitions.
